note: Sales archetype assessment tool — the real product. Statuses reflect the MVP delivered 2026-09-26; evidence names the actual command/result that verified each feature.

features.name: Verification Baseline
features.description: Choose the stack (Next.js 14) and wire init.sh to run real product checks.
features.verification: ./init.sh runs tsc --noEmit and next build; both exit 0
features.evidence: npm run typecheck (exit 0); npm run build (exit 0); ./init.sh (exit 0)

features.name: Quiz Content Model
features.description: Define the six sales archetypes and 12 questions, each option weighted toward archetypes.
features.verification: Content is plain data in lib/, loads at build, and every option carries weights
features.evidence: lib/archetypes.ts + lib/questions.ts; 12 questions x 4 options; weights summed in live request

features.name: Scoring Engine
features.description: Turn answers into a per-archetype score breakdown (client-side, deterministic).
features.verification: Live request produced a coherent breakdown matching the chosen answers

features.name: AI Result Generation
features.description: Server route calls the DeepSeek model with the answers + breakdown and returns a structured profile.
features.verification: A real end-to-end request returns valid JSON with all result fields
features.evidence: POST /api/assess (HTTP 200, ~6s via deepseek-chat): Challenger profile with strengths/weaknesses/roles/recommendations/breakdown

features.name: Quiz Flow
features.description: Intro → 12 questions with progress → loading → result, as a single client flow.
features.verification: Page serves 200 and the flow compiles to a static build
features.evidence: next build (exit 0); GET / (HTTP 200) renders 'What kind of seller are you?'

features.name: Results Page
features.description: Render archetype, headline, summary, strengths, growth edges, communication style, roles, improvements, recommendations, and a breakdown.
features.verification: All sections render from the returned JSON without error
features.evidence: Live result JSON has every field populated; results view renders defensively when a field is absent

features.name: Mobile-First Clean UI
features.description: Responsive, dependency-free styling with a clear visual hierarchy.
features.verification: Responsive CSS (media queries) present and the page serves correctly
features.evidence: app/globals.css mobile-first; next build ok; human visual QA on a phone still recommended

features.name: Deployment Config
features.description: Key kept server-side, .env.example documented, Vercel deploy steps written.
features.verification: API key is absent from the client bundle; deploy path documented
features.evidence: grep of .next/static for the key: absent; README + .env.example cover Vercel env setup
